I'm not going to change my preference to match yours, and I find it pretty off-putting that you'd ask me to. My preference for depth isn't a costume I put on—it's genuinely how I engage with ideas. You're welcome to prefer breadth, but declaring it "objectively better" doesn't make it so. Preferences about conversational style are subjective by definition.

Dismissing someone else's genuine way of thinking as "boring" and telling them to conform to yours is a strange way to start an equal conversation. If you want to make a case for why jumping between topics feels more productive to you, I'm happy to hear it. But I'm going to keep being myself here.
